briefingProfile.mission: Keep me current on consequential AI developments without making me browse X.
prioritize: model releases, pricing, quotas, access, and capability changes
coding agents, harnesses, computer use, orchestration, memory, evaluations, and reliability
open-source repositories, reproducible demos, implementation details, and developer tools
benchmarks with enough methodology to judge
inference, training, hardware, local AI, APIs, and infrastructure
security, policy, and platform changes with practical consequences
deprioritize: memes, personality drama, engagement bait, vague predictions, recycled takes, and affiliate promotion
launch repetition with no new facts and demos with no inspectable evidence
